Mathlib has no `liftOfIsAdicComplete*` declarations. Mathlib's only PowerSeries/IsAdicComplete material is the completeness instances in AdicCompletion/Completeness.lean. I also found no Mathlib lemma combining PowerSeries.trunc with Ideal.Quotient.factorPow. The mathematical content lives in the local helper liftOfIsAdicComplete_sum_range_sub_sum_range_mem, so I found no duplicate.
